settings.heading: Short and plain.
settings.text: Short sentences. Plain words. Nothing asks more of you than you have.

settings.heading: Skip what hurts today.
settings.text: Every page can stay empty. Come back to it, or don't.

settings.heading: Print it or use it on screen.
settings.text: Printable pages for a pen, and a digital workspace for the days a screen is easier.

settings.heading: Whatever is undone at 6 p.m. is forgiven.
settings.text: One box checked counts as getting through the hour.
